title: ScanList
description: Output of `spectra` (scan list): the matching scans of one run, one page of them listed.

format.description: Format id of the input file.

source.description:
`headers` when the reader listed scan headers without decoding peaks, `spectra` when
every spectrum had to be decoded to list it.

filter.description: The conditions applied (omitted when every scan is listed).

matched.description: Scans matching the conditions (all of them are counted, not only the page listed).

offset.description: Position of the first listed scan among the matching ones (0-based; `--offset`).

truncated.description: True when more matching scans follow the page (`offset + returned < matched`).

ms_level_counts.description: Counts of the matching scans per MS level (`"1"`, `"2"`, ...).

rt_range_s.description: Retention-time range of the matching scans in seconds.

scans.description: The listed scans, in spectrum-index order.

ScanFilter.description: Which scans to list. Every condition that is set must hold.

ms_level.description: Only this MS level (1 = full scans, 2 = MS/MS).

rt_min_s.description: Retention time at least this many seconds.

rt_max_s.description: Retention time at most this many seconds.

precursor_mz.description: Precursor m/z near this value (within `precursor_tol_mz`, or `precursor_tol_ppm`).

precursor_tol_mz.description: Absolute precursor tolerance in m/z (default 0.01 when neither tolerance is given).

charge.description: Only precursors of this charge state.

filter_contains.description: Only scans whose filter string contains this text (case-insensitive).

ScanHeader.description: Everything about one spectrum except its peaks.

index.description: Zero-based spectrum index within its run (`spectra --spectrum`).

scan_number.description: Scan number as the instrument counts it (`spectra --scan`).

native_id.description: The spectrum's identifier in its file (mzML `id`), when it has one.

ms_level.description: MS level: 1 for a full scan, 2 for a fragment (MS/MS) scan, and so on.

rt_s.description:
Retention time in seconds; null when the file states none for this scan (such a scan
never matches a retention-time filter).

centroided.description: True when the stored peaks are centroids.

precursor_mz.description: m/z of the isolated precursor ion (MS2 and above).

precursor_charge.description: Charge state of the precursor, when the instrument determined it.

precursor_intensity.description: Intensity of the selected precursor ion, when recorded.

isolation_window_mz.description: Precursor isolation window `[lower, upper]` in m/z.

inverse_reduced_mobility.description: Ion mobility 1/K0 in V·s/cm², when the scan or precursor has one.

scan_filter.description: Instrument scan filter or scan description (e.g. Thermo `FTMS + p ESI d Full ms2 …`).

total_ion_current.description:
Total ion current as the file records it for the scan (an index or header value; not
recomputed from the peaks). Absent when the file keeps none.

base_peak_mz.description: Base-peak m/z as the file records it for the scan.

base_peak_intensity.description: Base-peak intensity as the file records it for the scan.

point_count.description: Number of stored points (peaks or profile samples), when the header records it.

extra.description: Format-specific scan metadata in the reader's documented vocabulary.
